entities.summary: Gerdt Bernhard von Bassewitz-Hohenluckow was a German lieutenant in the Prussian militia, a writer, a playwright, and an actor. He had his only great success with Little Peter's Journey to the Moon, which began as a successful stage play in 1912 in Leipzig and was published as a book in 1915.
